nodes.label: Browser-side PDF toolkit (src/lib/pdf)
nodes.rationale: Everything runs in the browser so KYC documents never leave the device until the user actually submits; nothing is fetched until a PDF operation runs.

nodes.label: compressPdf policy (image-only, NotCompressibleError)
nodes.rationale: Re-rendering pages as JPEG is a good trade for a scan and a terrible one for a real document, so any page with text or vector paths is refused. A deny-list of pdf.js operators, not an allow-list, because real scanner output routinely carries clip paths and graphics-state changes. Never returns something bigger.

nodes.label: pdf-worker / pdf-render thread split
nodes.rationale: Workers are deliberately not nested and OffscreenCanvas is avoided — pdf.js's standard configuration already gets the expensive half off the main thread without betting on browser support. pdf-render.ts is dynamic-import-only because SSG prerender runs in bare Node.

nodes.label: FileUpload multi-file combine mode
nodes.rationale: Engages only when every accepted type is an image or PDF — a zone that also takes a spreadsheet keeps single-file behaviour rather than silently dropping what it cannot fold in. One attachment passes through as itself; combining starts at two.
